exams.name: Real Estate Broker Licensing Examination
exams.notes: Must demonstrate reasonable knowledge of estates and interests in real property, documents affecting property transfer, rights and duties of an agent, Hawaii real estate laws, and other subjects the commission deems essential.
exams.jurisdiction: state (commission-administered or via designated testing service agency)
exams.quote: Any individual applying for a real estate broker or salesperson license unless the individual has demonstrated by passing with a grade satisfactory to the commission an examination appropriate to the license sought

interval_years.quote: The biennial renewal fee and completed renewal application shall be submitted to the department of commerce and consumer affairs on or before the commission-prescribed deadline and prior to the expiration date of the license. All real estate licenses expire on December 31 of an even-numbered year.

required.quote: Prior to the license renewal of a real estate broker or real estate salesperson, the licensee shall provide the commission with proof of having attended at least twenty hours of continuing education or its equivalent as determined by the commission during the two-year period preceding the application for renewal.

hours_per_period.quote: proof of having attended at least twenty hours of continuing education or its equivalent as determined by the commission during the two-year period preceding the application for renewal

period_years.quote: during the two-year period preceding the application for renewal

available.quote: The commission may enter into a license recognition agreement with another state, or a jurisdiction recognized by the Association of Real Estate License Law Officials, with an equivalent real estate licensing law as determined by the commission.

requirements.value: The commission may enter into a license recognition agreement with another state or jurisdiction recognized by ARELLO with an equivalent real estate licensing law. disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any misrepresentation concerning any real estate transaction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any misrepresentation concerning any real estate transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false promises concerning a real estate transaction likely to mislead another
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false promises concerning any real estate transaction of a character likely to mislead another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation or making false promises through advertising or otherwise
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Pursuing a continued and flagrant course of misrepresentation, or making of false promises through advertising or otherwise

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting for both parties in a transaction without first obtaining written consent from both parties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Without first having obtained the written consent to do so of both parties involved in any real estate transaction, acting for both the parties in connection with the transaction

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson accepting commission from anyone other than their employing or associated broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a real estate salesperson, accepts any commission or other compensation for the performance of any of the acts enumerated in the definition set forth in section 467-1 of real estate salesperson from any person other than the real estate salesperson's employer or the real estate broker with whom the real estate salesperson associates

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson acting or attempting to act as a real estate broker or representing a broker other than their own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a real estate salesperson, acts or attempts to act as a real estate broker or represents, or attempts to represent, any real estate broker other than the real estate salesperson's employer or the real estate broker with whom the real estate salesperson is associated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing within a reasonable time to account for moneys belonging to others in the licensee's possession or control
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing, within a reasonable time, to account for any moneys belonging to others that may be in the possession or under the control of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct constituting fraudulent or dishonest dealings
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct constituting fraudulent or dishonest dealings

disciplinary_grounds.description: A partnership licensee permitting an unlicensed member to actively participate in brokerage business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a partnership, permits any member of the partnership who does not hold a real estate broker's license to actively participate in the real estate brokerage business thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: A corporate licensee permitting an unlicensed officer or employee to have direct management of the brokerage business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a corporation, permits any officer or employee of the corporation who does not hold a real estate broker's license to have the direct management of the real estate brokerage business thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: A salesperson failing to file with the commission a written statement of the employing or associated broker's name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a real estate salesperson, fails to file with the commission a written statement setting forth the name of the real estate broker by whom the licensee is employed or with whom the licensee is associated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to obtain confirmation on the contract of who the real estate broker represents
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee fails to obtain on the contract between the parties to the real estate transaction confirmation of who the real estate broker represents

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating chapter 467 or related statutes and rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating this chapter; chapter 484, 514B, 514E, or 515; section 516-71; or the rules adopted pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: Splitting fees with or otherwise compensating unlicensed persons for referring business
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Splitting fees with or otherwise compensating others not licensed hereunder for referring business

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commingling principal's money or property with the licensee's own
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commingling the money or other property of the licensee's principal with the licensee's own

disciplinary_grounds.description: Converting other people's moneys to the licensee's own use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Converting other people's moneys to the licensee's own use

disciplinary_grounds.description: Licensee is adjudicated insane or incompetent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The licensee is adjudicated insane or incompetent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to ascertain and disclose all material facts concerning every property for which the licensee accepts the agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to ascertain and disclose all material facts concerning every property for which the licensee accepts the agency, so that the licensee may fulfill the licensee's obligation to avoid error, misrepresentation, or concealment of material facts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or causing to be obtained any licensing examination or examination question for dissemination to future exam takers for gain
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee obtains or causes to be obtained, directly or indirectly, any licensing examination or licensing examination question for the purpose of disseminating the information to future takers of the examination for the benefit or gain of the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain a reputation for or record of competency, honesty, truthfulness, financial integrity, and fair dealing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to maintain a reputation for or record of competency, honesty, truthfulness, financial integrity, and fair dealing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acquiring an ownership interest in a distressed property listed with the licensee or within 365 days after the listing expires
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acquiring an ownership interest, directly or indirectly, or by means of a subsidiary or affiliate, in any distressed property that is listed with the licensee or within three hundred sixty-five days after the licensee's listing agreement for the distressed property has expired or is terminated

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in a manner that prohibits a prospective purchaser or seller from retaining the services of another broker
disciplinary_grounds.quote: When the licensee, being a real estate broker or a real estate salesperson, acting on behalf of a seller or purchaser of real estate, acts in a manner that prohibits a prospective purchaser or prospective seller of real estate from being able to retain the services of a real estate broker or real estate salesperson.

definition_quote.value: Real estate broker means any person who, for compensation or a valuable consideration, sells or offers to sell, buys or offers to buy, or negotiates the purchase or sale or exchange of real estate, or lists, or solicits for prospective purchasers, or who leases or offers to lease, or rents or offers to rent, or manages or offers to manage, any real estate, or the improvements thereon, for others, as a whole or partial vocation
definition_quote.quote: "Real estate broker" means any person who, for compensation or a valuable consideration, sells or offers to sell, buys or offers to buy, or negotiates the purchase or sale or exchange of real estate, or lists, or solicits for prospective purchasers, or who leases or offers to lease, or rents or offers to rent, or manages or offers to manage, any real estate, or the improvements thereon, for others, as a whole or partial vocation

value: list or solicit for prospective purchasers

license_tiers.quote: No person within the purview of this chapter shall act as real estate broker or real estate salesperson, or shall advertise, or assume to act as real estate broker or real estate salesperson without a license previously obtained under and in compliance with this chapter

broker_of_record_required.quote: Any corporation unless the real estate brokerage business thereof is under the direct management of a principal broker who is an officer or employee thereof and holds a current active real estate broker's license

pre_exam_experience_years.quote: Has experience as a full-time Hawaii-licensed real estate salesperson associated with a Hawaii-licensed real estate broker for at least three years of the five-year period immediately prior to the submission of the experience certification application

value: Estates, interests, and rights in real property
Documents or acts or occurrences by which property is transferred or otherwise affected
Rights and duties of an agent
Laws of the State relating to real estate brokers and salespersons
Other subjects the commission determines essential for protection of the general public
required_instruction_topics.quote: reasonable knowledge of: (A) Estates, interests, and rights in real property; (B) The documents or acts or occurrences by which property is transferred or otherwise affected; (C) The rights and duties of an agent; (D) The laws of the State relating to real estate brokers and salespersons; and (E) Other subjects that the commission determines to be essential for the protection of the general public in its real estate transactions

license_revocation_reapplication_waiting.quote: No real estate broker or real estate salesperson shall be eligible to receive a new license until the expiration of at least five years from the effective date of the termination of the license

dual_agency_written_consent_required.quote: Without first having obtained the written consent to do so of both parties involved in any real estate transaction, acting for both the parties in connection with the transaction

commingling_of_funds_prohibited.quote: Commingling the money or other property of the licensee's principal with the licensee's own

fixed_office_required.quote: A licensed real estate broker shall have and maintain a definite place of business in the State, in compliance with this chapter and the rules of the commission

salesperson_broker_affiliation_required.quote: Every real estate salesperson shall be under the direction of a real estate broker for all real estate transactions.

recovery_fund_exists.quote: The commission shall establish and maintain a trust fund which shall be known as the real estate recovery fund from which any person aggrieved by an act, representation, transaction, or conduct of a duly licensed real estate broker, or real estate salesperson, upon the grounds of fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, may recover

recovery_fund_max_per_claim.quote: an amount of not more than $25,000 per transaction for damages sustained by the fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit, including court costs and fees as set by law, and reasonable attorney fees as determined by the court

value: Owner acting on their own real estate or under power of attorney from the owner (not engaged in real estate development or brokerage)
Person acting as receiver, trustee in bankruptcy, personal representative, or trustee under court order
Individual who leases or rents real estate of which the individual is the custodian or caretaker
Person who manages, rents, or operates a hotel
Provider agency owning, leasing, operating, or managing a homeless facility authorized under part XVII of chapter 346
license_exemptions.quote: The provisions requiring licensing as a real estate broker or salesperson shall not apply: (1) To any individual who, as owner of any real estate or acting under power of attorney from the owner, performs any of the acts enumerated... (2) To any person acting as a receiver, trustee in bankruptcy, personal representative, or trustee... (3) To any individual who leases, offers to lease, rents, or offers to rent, any real estate or the improvements thereon of which the individual is the custodian or caretaker; (4) To any person who manages, rents, or operates a hotel; or (5) To any provider agency owning, leasing, operating, or managing a homeless facility
